## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `slack-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Sign in to Slack

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to [Slack](https://slack.com/). -->

## Step 3: Create a new Slack application

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to your apps in the [Slack API](https://api.slack.com/) and create a new Slack app. -->
2. <!-- manual: Provide an app name and select your workspace. -->
3. Select **Create App**.

## Step 4: Add scopes to the token

1. Under **Add Features and Functionality**, select **Permissions** to set the token scopes.
2. <!-- manual: In the User Token Scopes section, add the required scopes. -->
3. Select **Install to Workspace**.
4. <!-- manual: Copy the OAuth token generated upon installation. -->
